**Geometric Instabilities:** Direct dualization of power diagrams can produce zigzag artifacts.
**Neural SDF Gradients:** Neural SDFs (e.g., SIREN, VolSDF) do not guarantee unit-length gradients, making surface projections inaccurate.
**Gradient-Alignment Metric Bias:** The deviation metric may favor triangles far from the zero-level set if they are normal-aligned.
**Sign Flip Detection:** Must check all four vertices of a tetrahedron.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Proportional to the number of vertices and tetrahedra in the triangulation.
